posts.name: logan_mann
posts.cooked:
Rook City revealed two core hero nemesis (Wraith got Spite, Tachyon got the Matriarch), matched up Fixer and The Chairman, gave a new hero a core game nemesis (Expatriatte to Dawn), and added one new villain in need of a hero (Plague Rat).

Infernal Relics will be revealing 2 core hero nemesis (Ra and Fanatic’s) and matching up its 2 new heroes with a new villain nemesis.

We have Omnitron and Plague Rat as Villains with no hero yet so what they did with Expatriatte will surely need to happen at least twice (more if they pull another Plague Rat type villain intro in an expansion).

I can see >G continuing the trend of matching at least one new hero with a villain nemesis within the expansion. That lets them really emphasize the theme they go for in each expansion. And I love that they can tie in core game characters to each game theme. They’ve done this two at a time thus far. To me, Tachyon’s connection to Rook City seems to be the most vague connection, but I’ll take it. With the remaining four heroes i have a hard time putting them in groups of 2 thematically to tie into another expansion together. Visionary is so different in story from Haka, Bunker and Absolute Zero I have a hard time seeing her and another of those both be tied into a similarly themed expansion. Unless we see a Haka, Bunker or AZ from the future.

All these back story connections and character interweaving is one of my favorite things about this game. The greater world they have created. I look forward to seeing how this continues to be unvieled moving forward. I just really really hope that when >G feels the game has reached its capacity for expansions and such that there won’t be any loose ends in the nemesis department. I know comics never really have an end to their story, but i hope no characters are left out to dry.

Here’s a post of me speculating what the next expansion might be. It links Bunker and Absolute Zero, which I still see as a possibility as a future expansion but just not this one.

""Ronway"":

One thing I am thinking is that maybe it will contain another member of the Freedom Five’s home city. Due to the core game seems to lead more towards Legacy, containing his nemesis and possibly his home. Rook City contains The Wraith’s nemesis and her city, possibly Tachyon’s city as well? Leaving Bunker and Absolute Zero as the only two. Considering the fact that they are both sporting government funded suits it may have both their nemesis’ in it and contain a two environments that are government related.

Bunker’s nemesis: I can see being someone who acquired a mechanical suit (possibly a prototype of his suit that was stolen? Or even just a suit that was made and stolen.) The person behind it may be someone from the opposing side during the war with the middle east or someone part of his troop that didn’t like 'em for what ever the reason.

Absolute Zero’s nemesis: The one puts me at a bit of loss and have no real theory about. The only thing I can come up with is someone that does what Absolute Zero does with the same types of attack, maybe only sharing one of the types and the other is different, two different attack types, or possibly more than just two.

Environments: now if it is going by the whole government idea than I can see one environment being a testing area for weapons and such. Another one I thought of is maybe a battlefield where a war is taking place and the heroes and villian can get in the crossfire. That’s all I have come up with environments going along with the government idea.

All ideas are using Rook City as a start, considering it is the first expansion and only thing to go by. Two new villians that are nemesis’ from the base game (and as said before base game has Baron Blade with Legacy and Rook City has Spite and The Matriatch with The Wraith and Tachyon respectively), a new villian that has nemesis that is released with the game (I count Voss and Tempest from the base game and Rook City with The Chairman and Mr. Fixer), then there is the villian that has no known nemesis at all (Base game had two but they didn’t have a previous game and of course Rook City had Plague Rat).
